name: Sorry For the Rope
source:
What do you do when your kidnapper is  more nervous about this than you are?

High school is finally over! Time to start adulthood, tied up in a basement...?  With a guy who think kidnapping someone is the best way to start a conversation, it shouldn't be hard to get out of here (or not).
translation:
当绑架你的人比你还要紧张时，你该怎么办？

高中生活总算结束了！是时候迈向成年人的世界……结果却是被五花大绑地关在地下室里？面对一个觉得“绑架别人”是最佳搭讪方式的家伙，想要逃出去应该也不算太难吧（大概）。
